title: WCF to gRPC migration specification and work packages
description: Code-only target architecture, per-service Protobuf contracts, dependency-aware repository work packages, final local verification, and non-executable offline operational guidance.

wcfMutationPolicy.description: The code-only plugin keeps all inventoried WCF source, projects, configuration, activation, endpoints, and generated proxies unchanged.

semanticSubDigest.description: Digest of this package after applying the migration-spec lifecycle exclusions. It allows unchanged completed packages to survive unrelated bundle amendments.

rollbackPlan.description: Repository-code revert and local compatibility plan only; never a live environment rollback.

coexistencePlan.description: Code-side ability to keep WCF runnable alongside gRPC. It does not configure routing or execute traffic changes.
